item_arcane_focus_desc: A casting staff issued for the explicit Mage trial. No added physical ATK.
item_dew_bead_desc: A bead of meadow dew. Puddlekin leave them behind.
item_ember_root_desc: Chew to kindle your strikes: +25% attack for 60 seconds.
item_gale_plume_desc: Light as a rumor: +20% move speed for 60 seconds.
item_frontier_blade_desc: A standard-issue blade of the frontier watch. ATK +8.
item_gale_seed_desc: Sella's reward for waking the windmarks. It hums faintly.
item_meadow_box_desc: A reward box from the frontier meadow. Open it for a random item.
item_trail_potion_desc: Restores 40 HP. Carried into the field, up to 3.
bovine_shaman_greet: Welcome, traveler. I am Ruun, keeper of the city's old stories. Rest beside the fountain before you return to Sunmeadow. The road will still be there when you are ready.
sella_farewell: The verge breathes easier already. Rest at the regroup point if you fall.
sella_greet: Traveler! The windmarks have gone quiet. Wake three of them, cull the puddlekin spill, and return to me.
item_mvp_chest_desc: A boss MVP reward. Rune chance starts at 5% with pity.
